title: Apple opens repair centre in Harbor City
text: Apple has opened a device repair centre in Harbor City, creating about 120 local jobs. Mayor Linnea Voss attended the opening on Monday and said the centre would shorten waiting times for residents. The centre is located on Quay Street.

title: Nordvik Foods raises full-year profit forecast
text: Nordvik Foods raised its full-year profit forecast on Tuesday after strong demand for frozen meals. Chief financial officer Tomas Berg said operating margin would reach 11 percent. Shares of Nordvik Foods rose 6 percent in early trading on the Harbor Exchange.

title: Fjordbank collapses, regulators freeze deposits
text: Fjordbank, a regional lender based in Skarholm, collapsed on Wednesday after a run on deposits. Regulator Skarholm Financial Authority froze customer accounts and appointed Elena Marchetti as administrator. Thousands of residents queued outside branches, and the bank's shares were suspended on the Harbor Exchange.

title: Acme Corp names Dana Whitfield chief executive
text: Acme Corp announced on Monday that Dana Whitfield will become its chief executive officer, replacing Raj Patel. Whitfield previously ran the logistics division at Acme Corp. The board said the change takes effect immediately.

title: Acme Corp chief executive Raj Patel unveils factory plan
text: Acme Corp chief executive Raj Patel unveiled plans for a new factory in Brennan Valley on Thursday. Patel said the plant would employ 400 people. Acme Corp expects production to start next year.

title: Apple Inc. expands supplier network in Skarholm
text: Apple Inc. signed a supply agreement with Nordvik Foods to stock cafeterias at its new offices in Skarholm. Apple Inc. said the deal supports its local sourcing goals. Procurement head Jonas Aalto described the agreement as a three-year commitment.
